Coastal marine ecosystems across the globe are facing an alarming escalation in microplastic contamination. Synthetic polymers measuring less than five millimeters in diameter have infiltrated shallow nearshore waters, where they are ingested by zooplankton, benthic invertebrates, and juvenile fish. Because microplastics can absorb hydrophobic organic pollutants such as polychlorinated biphenyls and heavy metals from ambient seawater, their bioaccumulation across trophic levels poses severe physiological hazards to marine biodiversity and human consumers of seafood.

Conventional wastewater treatment facilities and shoreline filtration mechanisms remain largely ineffective at intercepting microplastic particles due to their microscopic dimensions and low specific gravities. However, recent marine ecological investigations have revealed that natural seagrass meadows (*Zostera marina* and *Posidonia oceanica*) function as highly potent biological filters. The dense subaquatic canopies of seagrass beds attenuate incoming coastal current velocities, causing suspended organic and inorganic sediments—along with buoyant plastic fragments—to settle into the seabed substrate. Furthermore, the fibrous root networks of seagrass physically entrap settled plastics, sequestering them under anaerobic sediment layers for decades. By mitigating the dispersal of particulate pollutants into open waters, conserved seagrass habitats provide an indispensable, cost-effective nature-based defense against marine plastic pollution.
questions.question_markdown: What is the best conclusion of the passage?
questions.conceptual_solution_markdown:
Wacana ini menggunakan struktur organisasi *Problem–Solution*:
1. Masalah (Paragraf 1): Eskalasi krisis mikroplastik di perairan pesisir yang terakumulasi dalam rantai makanan laut dan menyerap polutan berbahaya, mengancam keanekaragaman hayati dan konsumen manusia.
2. Evaluasi & Solusi (Paragraf 2): Instalasi pengolahan air limbah konvensional tidak mampu menyaring partikel mikroplastik karena ukurannya yang sangat kecil; sebaliknya, padang lamun (*seagrass meadows*) secara alami berfungsi sebagai biofilter melalui kanopi yang meredam arus dan jaringan akar yang memerangkap partikel plastik ke dalam sedimen dasar laut secara permanen.

Simpulan terbaik (*best conclusion*) harus menyintesis kedua pilar wacana ini: urgensi ancaman mikroplastik dan keefektifan padang lamun sebagai solusi mitigasi alami. Pilihan C secara sempurna merangkum hal tersebut (*Conserving natural seagrass meadows provides an essential ecological solution to entrap microplastics and alleviate coastal pollution that conventional filtration fails to intercept*).

Analisis Pengecoh:
- Opsi A salah karena teks tidak menyarankan penggantian total fasilitas limbah dengan sistem kimia industri (*minor speculation/distortion*).
- Opsi B salah karena mengajukan klaim ekstrem yang tidak didukung teks mengenai penghentian total konsumsi boga bahari (*extreme distortion*).
- Opsi D salah karena mendistorsi mekanisme biologis; lamun meredam arus melalui kerapatan fisik kanopi, bukan karena menyerap logam berat melalui daun (*factual distortion*).
- Opsi E salah karena menggunakan kuantor absolut yang keliru (*exclusively confined*), padahal mikroplastik menyebar luas di berbagai tingkat trofik perairan.

options.text_markdown: Conventional wastewater facilities must be entirely replaced by industrial chemical filtration systems to protect coastal zooplankton from hydrophobic pollutants.
Synthetic polymers in shallow coastal waters cannot be mitigated unless all human consumption of commercial seafood is permanently suspended.
Conserving natural seagrass meadows provides an essential ecological solution to entrap microplastics and alleviate coastal pollution that conventional filtration fails to intercept.
Seagrass meadows are effective at attenuating marine current velocities primarily because they absorb heavy metals directly through their leaf canopies.
The bioaccumulation of microplastics across trophic levels is exclusively confined to nearshore benthic invertebrates inhabiting temperate oceanic zones.

In modern metropolitan centers, the rapid substitution of permeable natural vegetation with impermeable dark asphalt surfaces, concrete highways, and high-density buildings has dramatically altered the local thermal equilibrium. This structural transformation gives rise to the Urban Heat Island (UHI) phenomenon, wherein urban centers experience surface and atmospheric temperatures significantly higher than their peripheral rural surroundings. Construction materials possessing high thermal mass absorb vast amounts of solar radiation throughout daylight hours, storing heat that would otherwise be dissipated through plant transpiration and natural soil moisture evaporation.

During nighttime hours, while rural soils rapidly cool through unrestricted radiative heat loss to the night sky, dense urban infrastructure slowly re-radiates stored thermal energy back into the planetary boundary layer. Consequently, urban nighttime temperatures often remain elevated by several degrees Celsius. This prolonged thermal retention forces residents and commercial establishments to dramatically increase their reliance on mechanical air conditioning systems to maintain habitable indoor environments. In turn, the continuous operation of millions of air conditioning units discharges massive volumes of anthropogenic waste heat directly into street canyons while drastically driving up municipal electricity consumption. Because fossil-fuel power grids still generate a substantial proportion of this supplementary electrical load, the heightened demand for artificial cooling exacerbates urban air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions, creating a reinforcing feedback loop of environmental degradation.
questions.question_markdown: Which of the following best expresses the overall conclusion of the passage?
questions.conceptual_solution_markdown:
Wacana menyajikan pola sebab–akibat berlapis (*multi-stage cause-and-effect*):
1. Sebab awal (Paragraf 1): Penggantian vegetasi alami dengan aspal dan beton penyerap panas memicu fenomena *Urban Heat Island* (UHI).
2. Akibat tahap pertama (Paragraf 2): Material bangunan melepaskan kembali panas tersimpan pada malam hari, menjaga suhu kota tetap tinggi.
3. Akibat tahap kedua (Paragraf 2): Tingginya suhu memaksa peningkatan pemakaian pendingin ruangan (AC).
4. Akibat tahap akhir / *feedback loop* (Paragraf 2): Operasi AC membuang panas antropogenik ke jalanan dan menuntut konsumsi listrik tambahan dari pembangkit fosil, yang berujung pada peningkatan emisi gas rumah kaca dan degradasi lingkungan perkotaan secara berkelanjutan.

Simpulan menyeluruh yang paling tepat adalah Pilihan E (*The Urban Heat Island effect initiates a compounding environmental cycle where infrastructure-driven heat retention elevates cooling demands, ultimately worsening municipal energy consumption and atmospheric emissions*).

Analisis Pengecoh:
- Opsi A salah karena mengusulkan kebijakan ekstrem yang tidak realistis dan tidak pernah dianjurkan oleh teks (*extreme speculation*).
- Opsi B salah karena membalik fakta teks; daerah perkotaanlah yang suhunya jauh lebih panas daripada pedesaan (*direct contradiction*).
- Opsi C salah karena mengklaim cat reflektif sebagai satu-satunya metode (*sole viable method*) yang tidak pernah dibahas di teks (*unsupported claim*).
- Opsi D salah karena bertentangan langsung dengan teks; beton justru lambat melepas panas pada malam hari (*factual reversal*).

options.text_markdown: Urban heat islands can be entirely eliminated if metropolitan municipalities prohibit the installation of residential air conditioning units.
Rural agricultural landscapes experience higher daytime surface temperatures than urban centers because open soil lacks artificial shade structures.
The replacement of asphalt highways with reflective paint represents the sole viable method to halt municipal electricity surges during daylight hours.
High-density concrete buildings cool down much more rapidly during nighttime hours than permeable vegetative landscapes in peripheral areas.

The Urban Heat Island effect initiates a compounding environmental cycle where infrastructure-driven heat retention elevates cooling demands, ultimately worsening municipal energy consumption and atmospheric emissions.

The transition toward ubiquitous electric mobility and renewable grid integration has been fundamentally shaped by continuous breakthroughs in electrochemical energy storage. During the mid-twentieth century, early rechargeable storage relied predominantly on lead-acid battery chemistries. While lead-acid systems offered reliable surge currents and low initial manufacturing costs, their excessive physical weight, low gravimetric energy density, and susceptibility to rapid sulfation during deep discharge cycles severely restricted their utility to vehicular starter batteries and stationary backup systems.

The subsequent introduction of commercial lithium-ion batteries in the early 1990s marked a profound paradigm shift. By leveraging the high electrochemical potential and light atomic mass of lithium ions intercalating between graphite anodes and transition metal oxide cathodes, lithium-ion cells achieved more than a threefold increase in energy density relative to preceding chemistries. However, modern lithium-ion batteries utilize flammable liquid organic electrolytes that present severe thermal runaway risks under mechanical damage, overcharging, or internal short-circuits. To transcend these safety and density thresholds, contemporary materials research is converging on solid-state battery architectures. By substituting volatile liquid electrolytes with inorganic solid ceramics or solid polymer matrices, solid-state designs not only eliminate combustibility but also enable the use of pure metallic lithium anodes, promising unprecedented energy storage capacity and operational longevity for next-generation applications.
questions.question_markdown: Which statement best synthesizes the technological progression described in the text?
questions.conceptual_solution_markdown:
Wacana disusun berdasarkan perkembangan kronologis (*chronological progression*) dari teknologi penyimpanan energi:
1. Era Awal (Paragraf 1): Baterai timbal-asam (*lead-acid*) yang berbobot berat, berdensitas energi rendah, dan rentan sulfasi.
2. Era Modern (Paragraf 2): Baterai litium-ion yang mendongkrak kepadatan energi hingga tiga kali lipat berkat ion litium, namun memiliki kelemahan berupa elektrolit cair organik yang mudah terbakar (*thermal runaway*).
3. Era Masa Depan (Paragraf 2): Baterai *solid-state* yang mengganti elektrolit cair dengan matriks padat anorganik/polimer, mengeliminasi risiko kebakaran sekaligus memaksimalkan kapasitas energi dengan anoda litium murni.

Simpulan yang menyintesis keseluruhan evolusi teknologi ini adalah Pilihan A (*Energy storage technology has systematically evolved across generations from bulky, low-density chemistries toward higher energy densities and enhanced safety via solid-state architectures*).

Analisis Pengecoh:
- Opsi B salah karena mengklaim baterai timbal-asam paling banyak dipakai di kendaraan listrik modern (*factual falsehood*).
- Opsi C salah karena mengklaim litium-ion menghapus semua risiko (*completely eradicated all operational risks*), padahal teks menyebutkan risiko terbakarnya elektrolit cair.
- Opsi D salah karena berspekulasi berlebihan bahwa solid-state telah membuat semua pabrik litium-ion usang saat ini (*unwarranted present-day claim*).
- Opsi E salah karena menyimpulkan konsep keliru yang tidak relevan dengan kimia baterai (*irrelevant distortion*).

options.text_markdown: Energy storage technology has systematically evolved across generations from bulky, low-density chemistries toward higher energy densities and enhanced safety via solid-state architectures.
Lead-acid batteries remain the most widely deployed electrochemical system across modern electric vehicles owing to their superior surge current delivery.
Lithium-ion batteries completely eradicated all operational risks associated with electrochemical energy storage when first introduced in the 1990s.
Solid-state battery architectures have already rendered all liquid-electrolyte lithium-ion manufacturing facilities obsolete throughout global markets.
The electrochemical potential of battery cells is fundamentally dictated by the physical thickness of external casing materials rather than internal electrolytes.

For over a century, ornithologists were baffled by the ability of migratory European robins (*Erithacus rubecula*) to navigate thousands of kilometers between seasonal breeding grounds with millimeter precision, even in the total absence of visual celestial landmarks. In the late twentieth century, biophysicists proposed a radical theoretical hypothesis: avian magnetoreception is governed by quantum mechanical processes occurring within specialized cryptochrome photopigment proteins embedded in the birds' retinas. According to the radical pair mechanism, incoming photons of light excite cryptochrome-4 molecules, triggering an electron transfer between flavin adenine dinucleotide and a chain of tryptophan amino acid residues. This photochemical reaction generates a pair of spatially separated but entangled electron spins whose quantum recombination rate is modulated by extremely subtle inclinations of Earth's geomagnetic field.

To subject this theoretical construct to rigorous empirical verification, behavioral researchers conducted controlled laboratory trials exposing captive European robins to artificial electromagnetic environments. When the birds were housed in orientation funnels under blue-spectrum illumination with access to a static geomagnetic field, they consistently displayed accurate migratory orientation toward their ancestral migratory corridors. However, when researchers introduced weak, high-frequency oscillating radio waves—a frequency known to disrupt the coherence of entangled electron pairs—the birds completely lost their navigational orientation, scattering randomly. Furthermore, when tested under monochromatic red light, which cannot activate the flavin photopigment, the robins exhibited total disorientation despite undisturbed geomagnetic fields. These empirical experiments definitively confirmed that avian magnetic navigation is not an autonomous sensory faculty, but a light-dependent quantum mechanism physically localized within the retinal biochemical cascade.
questions.question_markdown: What can be concluded from the relationship between the theoretical hypothesis and empirical findings presented in the passage?
questions.conceptual_solution_markdown:
Wacana memadukan klaim teoretis dan pembuktian empiris (*theory-to-evidence conclusion*):
1. Klaim Teoretis (Paragraf 1): Hipotesis mekanisme pasangan radikal kuantum pada protein kriptokrom-4 di retina burung robin yang dipicu oleh foton cahaya dan dipengaruhi medan geomagnetik bumi.
2. Bukti Empiris (Paragraf 2): Uji laboratorium membuktikan bahwa burung mampu bernavigasi di bawah cahaya biru dan medan magnet statis, namun navigasinya lumpuh saat diberi gelombang radio berfrekuensi tinggi (yang mengacaukan belitan spin elektron) atau saat diberi cahaya merah (yang tidak mampu mengaktifkan pigmen foton).
3. Sintesis: Eksperimen empiris tersebut memvalidasi teori bahwa navigasi magnetik burung merupakan mekanisme kuantum bergantung cahaya di retina.

Kesimpulan yang tepat adalah Pilihan D (*Empirical laboratory experiments validated the theoretical hypothesis by demonstrating that European robin navigation relies on light-activated quantum magnetoreception in the retina*).

Analisis Pengecoh:
- Opsi A salah karena bertentangan langsung dengan premis paragraf 1 (*direct contradiction*).
- Opsi B salah karena teks secara eksplisit menyatakan burung kehilangan orientasi total di bawah cahaya merah (*factual distortion*).
- Opsi C salah karena mengklaim teori terpatahkan (*thoroughly disproven*), padahal teori justru tervalidasi secara meyakinkan (*definitively confirmed*).
- Opsi E salah karena membalik pengaruh gelombang radio; gelombang radio mengacaukan navigasi, bukan membantu (*reversal of effect*).

options.text_markdown: Avian migration is primarily guided by visual celestial landmarks rather than biochemical receptors located in the eyes.
Captive European robins are capable of navigating under monochromatic red light because red wavelengths amplify entangled electron spin coherence.
The radical pair theory was thoroughly disproven because captive robins scattered randomly under undisturbed static geomagnetic fields.
Empirical laboratory experiments validated the theoretical hypothesis by demonstrating that European robin navigation relies on light-activated quantum magnetoreception in the retina.
High-frequency oscillating radio waves naturally assist migratory birds in maintaining precise orientation during overcast nighttime flights.

The environmental footprint of conventional animal agriculture has catalyzed intense commercial interest in cellular agriculture, particularly the production of cultivated meat synthesized from animal stem cells grown in bioreactors. Proponents highlight that cultivating animal tissue directly from muscle satellite cells circumvents the resource-intensive rearing and slaughter of livestock. Life-cycle assessments indicate that large-scale cultivated meat production could decrease agricultural land requirements by up to ninety-five percent and reduce anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions, particularly enteric methane produced by ruminants, by nearly eighty percent compared to conventional beef farming. Furthermore, because cultivated meat is manufactured within sterile, hermetically sealed bioreactors, it eliminates the necessity for subtherapeutic antibiotic administration, significantly curtailing the proliferation of multi-drug-resistant zoonotic pathogens.

Nevertheless, transitioning cultivated meat from laboratory demonstrations to viable industrial commodification entails substantial technoeconomic hurdles. Maintaining the high metabolic growth rates of cellular cultures requires nutrient-rich growth media formulated with pharmaceutical-grade amino acids, glucose, and recombinant signaling proteins, which currently dominate operational production costs. Moreover, cultivating mammalian cells in large-volume industrial bioreactors demands rigorous environmental temperature maintenance and sterile air filtration, resulting in immense electricity and thermal energy expenditures. Unless these commercial bioreactor facilities are powered exclusively by low-carbon electrical grids, their operational carbon emissions could partially offset the agricultural land and methane savings achieved. Therefore, realizing the transformative environmental potential of cultivated meat depends as much on solving engineering bottlenecks and scaling renewable energy infrastructure as on consumer adoption.
questions.question_markdown: Which of the following represents the most balanced conclusion of the passage?
questions.conceptual_solution_markdown:
Wacana membandingkan sisi keunggulan (*pro*) dan tantangan (*kontra*) dari daging kultur seluler:
1. Sisi Positif (Paragraf 1): Penghematan lahan hingga 95%, penurunan emisi gas rumah kaca/metana hingga 80%, serta eliminasi kebutuhan antibiotik dan patogen zoonotik.
2. Sisi Tantangan (Paragraf 2): Mahalnya media kultur sel (asam amino dan protein rekombinan), konsumsi energi listrik dan termal yang sangat besar untuk menjaga sterilitas bioreaktor, serta ketergantungan pada jaringan listrik rendah karbon.

Simpulan yang berimbang (*balanced trade-off conclusion*) harus merefleksikan kedua dimensi ini: potensi ekologis yang besar di satu sisi, dan keharusan mengatasi kendala biaya formulasi serta konsumsi energi di sisi lain. Hal ini dinyatakan dengan tepat oleh Pilihan B (*Cultivated meat offers profound ecological advantages in land and methane reduction, but realizing its commercial promise requires overcoming steep production costs and energy demands*).

Analisis Pengecoh:
- Opsi A salah karena mengklaim daging kultur telah menggantikan seluruh peternakan global dan berbiaya nol (*extreme overstatement*).
- Opsi C salah karena membalik fakta ilmiah; bioreaktor tidak menghasilkan emisi metana enterik ruminansia (*factual error*).
- Opsi D salah karena mengklaim pengembangan telah ditinggalkan total (*unjustified pessimism/distortion*).
- Opsi E salah karena mengklaim sistem pangan tidak butuh listrik perkotaan (*illogical speculation*).

options.text_markdown: Cultivated meat has fully replaced conventional livestock farming worldwide due to its zero-cost growth media and minimal operational energy requirements.
Cultivated meat offers profound ecological advantages in land and methane reduction, but realizing its commercial promise requires overcoming steep production costs and energy demands.
Conventional livestock agriculture remains ecologically superior to cultivated meat because industrial bioreactors produce more enteric methane than ruminants.
High pharmaceutical costs have rendered cultivated meat research completely unviable, forcing commercial biotech developers to abandon cellular agriculture.
Cultivated meat eliminates all agricultural land use, ensuring that food production systems will operate independently of municipal electrical grids.

Upon reaching the tunnel exit portal, these compressed air pulses erupted into loud, disruptive acoustic booms that rattled nearby residential buildings and exceeded environmental noise limits.

Faced with this challenge, lead engineer and avid birdwatcher Eiji Nakatsu turned to the principles of biomimicry to fundamentally redesign the train's structural aerodynamics. By reshaping the Shinkansen's nose cone into an aerodynamic profile modeled after the kingfisher's beak, and incorporating serrated pantograph geometries inspired by the silent flight feathers of owls, engineers transformed the train's fluid dynamics. As freshwater scarcity intensifies across arid and semi-arid coastal territories, municipal water authorities rely increasingly on large-scale seawater desalination technologies. Historically, thermal desalination, particularly Multi-Stage Flash (MSF) distillation, dominated global freshwater production. In MSF facilities, saline water is sequentially heated in a brine heater and passed into successive low-pressure flash chambers, where vapor rapidly boils off and condenses into potable freshwater. While MSF systems demonstrate remarkable robustness against fluctuating feed-water turbidity and high salinity, they consume tremendous quantities of thermal and electrical energy, necessitating close physical co-location with fossil-fuel power stations or industrial cogeneration plants.

Conversely, modern membrane-based Reverse Osmosis (RO) has emerged as the prevailing global desalination standard. In RO plants, seawater is pressurized across semi-permeable polyamide membranes that physically exclude dissolved sodium and chloride ions while permitting freshwater molecules to pass. RO systems consume significantly less energy per cubic meter of purified water than MSF distillation and integrate seamlessly with renewable solar and wind electrical sources. However, RO facilities face higher operational vulnerabilities regarding membrane biofouling, demanding intensive chemical pre-treatment and periodic membrane module replacements that generate continuous operational expenditures. Consequently, urban water utility planners must carefully assess regional energy infrastructure, feed-water characteristics, and capital resources when selecting an optimal desalination paradigm.
questions.question_markdown: What is the overall conclusion regarding the two desalination methods discussed in the text?
questions.conceptual_solution_markdown:
Wacana membandingkan dua pendekatan metodologis desalinasi air laut (*compare-and-contrast synthesis*):
1. Distilasi Termal *Multi-Stage Flash* (MSF): Tahan terhadap kekeruhan dan salinitas tinggi, tetapi membutuhkan konsumsi energi termal dan listrik yang sangat besar serta harus berdampingan dengan pembangkit listrik.
2. *Reverse Osmosis* (RO): Jauh lebih hemat energi per meter kubik air dan mudah dipadukan dengan energi terbarukan, tetapi rentan terhadap *biofouling* membran sehingga butuh pra-pengolahan kimiawi dan pergantian membran berkala.
3. Sintesis (akhir Paragraf 2): Pemilihan teknologi desalinasi yang optimal bergantung pada infrastruktur energi regional, sifat air baku, dan ketersediaan modal lokal.

Simpulan menyeluruh yang tepat dinyatakan pada Pilihan A (*The choice between reverse osmosis and thermal distillation depends on local energy infrastructure, feed-water conditions, and operational trade-offs rather than a universal standard*).

Analisis Pengecoh:
- Opsi B salah karena membalik karakteristik; *membrane biofouling* adalah kelemahan RO, bukan MSF, dan MSF tidak dilarang secara hukum (*cross-contamination of details*).
- Opsi C salah karena mengklaim RO menghasilkan air tidak murni (*unsubstantiated disparagement*).
- Opsi D salah karena mengklaim desalinasi ditinggalkan sama sekali di negara pesisir gersang (*extreme distortion*).
- Opsi E salah karena mengklaim MSF tidak menggunakan energi sama sekali (*blatant factual error*).

options.text_markdown: The choice between reverse osmosis and thermal distillation depends on local energy infrastructure, feed-water conditions, and operational trade-offs rather than a universal standard.
Thermal distillation has been entirely outlawed internationally due to its vulnerability to polyamide membrane biofouling.
Reverse osmosis produces water of inferior purity compared to natural rainfall, making it unsuitable for municipal utility networks.
Seawater desalination technologies have been completely abandoned in arid coastal nations in favor of long-distance freshwater trucking.
Multi-Stage Flash distillation is universally superior to membrane systems because it consumes zero energy during thermal condensation.

Polyethylene terephthalate (PET) is among the most widely manufactured synthetic polymers in the world, ubiquitous in single-use beverage containers, synthetic apparel fibers, and consumer packaging. However, traditional mechanical recycling methods exhibit profound structural limitations. During repeated thermomechanical re-extrusion, PET polymer chains suffer hydrolytic scission and thermal degradation, resulting in a progressive deterioration of tensile strength and optical clarity. Consequently, most mechanically recycled PET cannot be re-manufactured into high-grade food-contact bottles, resulting in a downcycling trajectory where plastics are converted into lower-grade textiles and ultimately discarded into municipal landfills.

To overcome this downcycling impasse, biochemical researchers have pioneered enzymatic chemical recycling utilizing engineered variants of *PETase*, an enzyme originally discovered in the bacterium *Ideonella sakaiensis*. Unlike physical grinding and melting, PETase catalyzes the depolymerization of PET ester bonds under mild ambient temperatures, rapidly breaking down complex plastics into their fundamental chemical monomer building blocks: terephthalic acid and ethylene glycol. In recent European pilot-scale demonstration facilities, bio-engineers processed metric tons of mixed post-consumer colored plastic waste with optimized PETase enzymes. The resulting monomer yields exceeded ninety percent purity within sixteen hours, allowing chemists to synthesize pristine, virgin-quality PET resin that seamlessly matches the thermal and mechanical standards of fossil-derived plastics. This biotechnological breakthrough establishes the technical feasibility of an authentic closed-loop circular economy for plastic waste.
questions.question_markdown: What is the primary conclusion drawn from the development and testing of engineered PETase enzymes?
questions.conceptual_solution_markdown:
Wacana memaparkan perbandingan antara daur ulang mekanis dan enzimatik:
1. Masalah Daur Ulang Mekanis (Paragraf 1): Proses peleburan fisik berulang merusak rantai polimer (*downcycling*), menurunkan kejernihan optik dan kekuatan tarik sehingga plastik akhirnya tetap berakhir di tempat pembuangan akhir.
2. Terobosan Enzimatik *PETase* (Paragraf 2): Varian enzim PETase hasil rekayasa biokatalitik mampu memutus ikatan ester PET pada suhu moderat menjadi monomer murni (asam tereftalat dan etilen glikol) dengan kemurnian >90%. Uji coba skala pilot di Eropa membuktikan monomer ini dapat disintesis kembali menjadi resin PET berkualitas setara bahan murni (*virgin-quality*).
3. Simpulan Utama: Rekayasa enzim PETase mewujudkan ekonomi sirkular tertutup (*closed-loop circular economy*) yang sejati untuk daur ulang sampah plastik.

Pilihan C secara akurat menangkap simpulan utama tersebut (*Engineered PETase enzymes enable true closed-loop plastic recycling by breaking down waste into pure monomers to produce virgin-grade PET without quality loss*).

Analisis Pengecoh:
- Opsi A salah karena bertentangan langsung dengan teks; daur ulang mekanis justru memiliki keterbatasan berat (*direct contradiction*).
- Opsi B salah karena mengklaim enzim bakteri tidak mampu memecah polimer (*factual reversal*).
